source_policy_verdict: No remaining source/private-native blocker identified for root guarded integration. FinalMap/Main/title/pause/selection/actual save paths and full regression remain separate gates.
resolved_private_blocker: Original56 source observes then ignores late.tmp/.bak.tmp data after own write. Successor checks all four expected byte signatures and own serialized bytes before copy/eachrename; deterministicoldguard witness fails six checks while all original56 remain positive.
limits: Nine engine-input records per project, not fourteen. The outer Python launcher was post-preserved and not before-bound; no reconstructed stronger identity claim.
Code-only native fixtures use private XDG/user paths; no Main/world/HUD/AppleMusic object is constructed.
This is optimistic stale/conflict detection, not an interprocess lock or proof of complete filesystem race freedom.
Root owns lazy selected-world and UI; pure serializers do not prove one liveworld, contact reset, menu/controller cancellation, playability or fun.
Custom isolated callers must explicitly disable default legacy fallback; ordinary new-book load can migrate old profiles only when all four new slots are absent.
Current real profile migration/save and Mac filesystem/device behaviour remain unmeasured.
Metadata world paths are strings; the proposedMerchant script existence is an implementation prerequisite, not inferred from catalog validation.
